METHODS:
Money math

  • Hold = Σ house win ÷ Σ coin-in (ratio of sums). Floor hold 9.50% vs. 9.46% theo; a mean of daily holds would wrongly give 9.25%.
  • Theo = Σ bet × (1 − published RTP). Luck = house win − theo.
  • Luck uncertainty: Var(house win) = Σ bet² × Var(payout multiplier) from game_math (exact for the bets played; uses sum_bet_squared). z = luck ÷ SD; 95% range = ±1.96 SD. Hit-rate test: binomial z against hit_probability.
  • Only on-floor days (1,018 off-floor rows excluded). Exposure = available hours (scheduled − downtime); Mar 8 has 23 hours.
  • Location by day from machine_day.location_id (machines move). Cents converted once. Comp cost counted once (it sits inside POS cost of goods).
  • Player tables are carded play only (65.8% of coin-in); they reconcile to machine_day.carded_* to the cent.

Verdict rules (section 6, applied in order)

  1. Payout lead: luck z < −3 or hit-rate z > 4 → inspect.
  2. Short window: < 90 days on the floor.
  3. Availability: availability < 98.5% and downtime cost > 5% of theo.
  4. Weak game for its spot: theo per available hour < 75% of zone peers, and coin-in per hour not above peers. In practice these are loose (92–95% RTP) titles: guests play them about as much, but the game keeps less. The fix is moving the game, not repairing the machine.
  5. Location: the machine's zone earns < 80% of floor theo per hour.
  6. Unlucky: below theo but within noise; otherwise OK.

Limitations

  • Synthetic data; real-world magnitudes will differ. Supplied costs are partial (no rent, tax, full labour); benefits are theo, not profit.
  • The zone + title model's R² (0.97) is partly mechanical, because theo = coin-in × house edge. But zone + title also explain 95% of coin-in per hour, which has no edge built in, and title effects estimated separately in the Back Forty and in prime zones correlate 0.97, so a title keeps its relative earning power when moved. Tighter games draw a little less play (10% more edge → ~2% less coin-in per hour), with no extra penalty in prime zones.
  • Zone and title effects are observational. The M-1152 move and the walkway closure are the only natural experiments, and the swap plan includes a measurement design for that reason.
  • Player concentration covers carded play only. Uncarded guests can't be profiled.
  • Event uplift CIs rest on 13–19 placebo windows. The forecast was selected on a single month of inner validation.
  • Anomalies are leads to inspect, never accusations.
